transcript: Ugh, the train was delayed like twenty minutes so I was late for standup, which was annoying because I hate walking in late. But then in the afternoon Priya and I finally got the reporting bug fixed that's been haunting us all week, so that felt really good. Came home and just made pasta, nothing fancy.
